labels.name: bug
labels.description: Observed failure or discrepancy requiring diagnosis

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Requested capability; captured ideas default to deferred

labels.name: research
labels.description: Primary-source investigation with a scoped answer

labels.name: field-test
labels.description: Planned measured bench or field acceptance check

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Prerequisite issue or external condition is named in the issue

labels.name: priority:high
labels.description: Important within the owner priority order; not extra authorization

labels.name: priority:normal
labels.description: Normal priority within the agreed scope

labels.name: status:triage
labels.description: Scope, priority, prerequisites or acceptance criteria need review

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Bounded next step subject to stated authorization and blockers

labels.name: status:in-progress
labels.description: Claimed by the named active session or person

labels.name: status:verify
labels.description: Preparation exists; scoped acceptance checks remain

labels.name: status:deferred
labels.description: Parked; explicit owner activation required before work

milestones.title: Reliable bench tracking
milestones.description: Evidence gate: sustained phone-free GPS freshness/runtime, forced relay and outage/local viewing, both-gateway delivery, trustworthy power diagnosis and off-host recovery. Four-hour minimum, 12-hour runtime target; 15-minute stale threshold. Counts are not readiness scores.

milestones.title: Measured field pilot
milestones.description: After bench evidence: confirmed available devices, owner-agreed route/access and stale/missing delivery criteria, measured coverage/GPS age/runtime/recovery. Candidate sites are not installation permission; no promised date.

milestones.title: Repeatable member rollout
milestones.description: After accepted field evidence and owner activation: confirmed stock, repeatable provisioning/assignment, handout/training, maintenance/support and verified procedure. No purchases or distribution authorized by this milestone.
